Banregio.com, from website to digital branch

2022

Map everyone the service depends on

The UX team was born inside Marketing. Before touching the site, I mapped internal clients, employees, providers and every area that kept it relevant, and evaluated how the service worked for each.

2023

Make it measurable

The first dashboard for the site: sessions, visits and return on organic leads, plus new tags and a web-to-lead tracker shared with branches.

+60%

commercial sales originated by the website in year one.

2024

Bring the right partners in

The result earned a bigger team and two partners: USARIA, five researchers for four months of fieldwork, and INTERIUS, four SEO strategists for a year. Design Thinking, Agile and Scrum.

2024

Go to the field

Immersion with internal areas, a benchmark of digital and hybrid banks, and usability tests with 56 participants: card sorting and one-hour task sessions. We also blueprinted the branch.

2024

Ship the MVP, keep the site selling

While local SEO, A/B tests and new contracting flows kept the live site working, we designed a new content architecture, UX and tagging, plus digital points in branches for assisted sign-ups.

Ongoing

Measure, then iterate

Dashboards for the site, Google Business and microsites track visits, session time, journey starts and organic search, so every next decision has data behind it.
